evidence: Quick planning allowances and arithmetic on the committed sports and entertainment scenarios. No engineering quotation, acquisition-cost measurement, success probability, peak funding schedule or optimal build-out is established. Lower/middle/higher are illustrative combinations, not confidence limits.
reading_rule: Gross uses through development, full hosted build-out and initial audience growth, before crediting early receipts. Includes development effort at a compensation proxy, installed assets once, construction contingency, 6-12 months of full-programme operations at base pay without receipts, a separate renewal reserve, and initial paid promotion. No generic working-capital percentage or earlier small-venue launch total is added. Entertainment includes sports; only its difference is incremental. Pilot work precedes regular operations and excludes assets already in installed capital.

humanities/economics/results/sports.json.use: Existing physical capital, participant costs, acquired audience and renewal; kept unchanged.

humanities/economics/results/entertainme.use: Existing physical capital, participant costs, acquired audience and renewal; kept unchanged.

small_exploration.scope: Small digital or content prototype; a subset of the larger discovery allowance, not an extra line in full build-out.

discovery.scope: Several sport concepts, low-cost motion and gameplay work, audience interviews and short media experiments.

games_and_formats.scope: Playable digital products, event formats, rights and club administration, brand/production tools and community development; owned effort is costed even if cash pay is deferred.

physical_pilot.scope: Qualification, instruction, medical and engineering services, practice events and production commissioning; rented equipment and consumables only. Travel and guest nights added explicitly.

additional_entertainment_formats.scope: Additional documentary, performance and commissioned-production development beyond shared sports work.

assumption_notes.capital: Inherited 200 million U for two sports venues and 200 guest beds; 230 million U including entertainment studio. No new component-level construction estimate. All cases require an already funded host; host construction and infrastructure expansions remain outside these uses. Freight/installation must fit installed allowances or be added when priced. A 20-40% contingency does not bound missing engineering.
assumption_notes.audience: Alternative initial-promotion cases assume paid promotion reaches 10%, 30% or 100% of paying customers at an assumed 8 U per paid-sourced customer. Organic reach carries no extra purchased-promotion charge here; content and community labour are separately budgeted. The old 8 U averaged across every acquired customer remains in the annual operating models. No paid share, virality or guaranteed interest is inferred.
assumption_notes.runway: Cash support for the full programme at base payroll and fixed physical purchases, without receipts for 6-12 months. Successful-property revenue-linked pay is excluded because receipts are zero. Existing variable commercial costs and churn acquisition are excluded from this runway; initial audience promotion is separate. Renewal is funded once as a liquidity reserve. With revenues and obligations timed, actual peak outside funding could differ substantially.
assumption_notes.financing: Optional 20-million-U debt memo inherits rate, fees and reserve convention; construction interest uses explicit duration and average drawn fraction. No debt or investor commitment is assumed in gross uses. Supplier advances and payroll are covered by runway liquidity; no dated receivables, tax or contract-payment schedule is modeled.
assumption_notes.effort: The 120,000 U per person-year proxy inherits the prior production-worker assumption. It is an economic effort cost, not an assertion that every founder must draw that cash salary; the apparent saving from unpaid work does not guarantee successful products.
assumption_notes.spectator_hospitality: Guest accommodation here serves visiting athletes, artists and crews. General hospitality is budgeted in research/studies/world_economy/early_exports.md and visitor packages in sports_finance.md, but additional spectators and their hotel expansion are not estimated in this screen. Shared capacity and package receipts require reconciliation before combination; extra beds, services and transport cannot be assumed free.

source_review.title: World Bank PPP Resource Center: Key Issues in Developing Project Financed Transactions
source_review.use: Separate operating revenue expectations from construction funding and test cost/revenue sensitivities.
source_review.limit: No source price, recommended contingency percentage or lunar financing standard transferred; all new amounts are scenario choices.
